correctness.rationale: PASS: Deleting the root in a uniform random recursive tree yields a labeled set of increasing rooted branches, with each size-s branch (s−1)! structures and EGF z^s/s. Root protected iff no size-one branch; F(z)=e^(−z)/(1−z) and Pr(R_n)=f_(n−1). Marking internal path length s(H_s−1) gives conditional mean N+(1/f_N) sum_(s=2..N) (H_s−1)f_(N−s), while unconditional mean is n(H_n−1). Pair even/odd alternating partial sums f_j−f_N with decreasing positive harmonic weights to obtain strict positive Delta_n for all N≥2. The generating function for ε_j=f_j−e^(−1), with sum ε_j=e^(−1) and sum j ε_j=−e^(−1)/2, proves Delta_n=H_N−1+1/(2N)+O(N^(−2)). Independently enumerated every recursive-tree parent map n3..8 and checked exact probabilities and conditional mean. Finite enumeration is corroborative, not the all-n proof.
